reviews.comment:
El encargado nos echó porque no estabamos consumiendo (acababamos de entrar y le dijimos que esperara un segundo que estabamos esperando a alguien) pero parece que no se puede estar un segundo sin consumir. La verdad que el trato espantoso, porque nosotros estabamos con la idea de tomarnos un café, pero fueron tan desubicados que nos fuimos.

(Translated by Google)
The manager kicked us out because we weren't ordering anything (we had just walked in and told him to wait a second, we were waiting for someone), but apparently you can't be out of the room for even a second without ordering. The service was truly awful, because we were planning to have a coffee, but they were so rude that we left.
